content.title: Bayern Munich 4-3 Real Madrid: summary, score, goals, highlights,  Champions League quarter final
content.text: Bayern Munich vs Real Madrid: live onlineBayern 4-3 Real Madrid (match report)In what will immediately be remembered as a Champions League classic, Bayern Munich defeated Real Madrid 4–3 (6–4 on aggregate) at the Allianz Arena to secure a spot in the semi-finals.The match was a breathless, back-and-forth thriller that saw Luis Díaz and Michael Olise score dramatic late goals in the 88th and 93rd minutes to finally break a persistent aggregate deadlock. Real Madrid had clawed their way into a leading position during a chaotic first half behind a brace from Arda Güler and a clinical Kylian Mbappé strike, but their hopes collapsed late in the second half following a red card for Eduardo Camavinga.Harry Kane and Aleksandar Pavlović also found the net for the Bavarians, who successfully fended off the 15-time champions to set up a semi-final clash against Paris Saint-Germain.Posted at: 17:12 EDT 15/04/2026 and modified at 17:13 EDT 15/04/2026 We'll wrap up our coverage from the Allianz Arena here folks after what was truly a dramatic night of Champions League football which ultimately saw Bayern Munich march on to the semi-final where they will meet PSG.Arsenal will entertain Atletico Madrid in the other match-up with those games set to be played in a fortnight.Cheers for tuning in this evening.Posted at: 17:54 EDT 15/04/2026 PSG getting ready for semi-finalJust another two weeks to wait until the Champions League is back with the final four sides.A fascinating repeat of the Covid Lisbon final when Bayern beat PSG by 1-0.Arsenal finally got over the line against Sporting CP in a game apparently short of clear cut chances.Atletico will be no pushovers and that too, will be an intriguing match-up.Posted at: 17:37 EDT 15/04/2026 FLORENTINO PEREZ / PEPE ANDRES / DIARIO ASFlorentino Perez commiserates with Madrid squadAccording to Movistar +, Real Madrid president Florentino Perez went to the away dressing room at the Allianz Arena to commiserate with the Madrid squad after their 4-3 loss to Bayern Munich.Los Blancos also fell at the quarter-final stage last season following elimination at the hands of Arsenal.Posted at: 17:31 EDT 15/04/2026 Arbeloa post game:"I think that the game changed after the red card and I can't believe that Camavinga was sent off for that incident. We're annoyed and we accept that things in LaLiga are complicated given that Barcelona are nine points clear at the top of the table"Posted at: 17:20 EDT 15/04/2026 There was a serious fracas at the end of the game and it appeared that Arda Güler was red carded as Jude Bellingham also challenged the match official.The tension also apparently continued in the tunnel after the final whistle.Posted at: 17:18 EDT 15/04/2026 Posted at: 17:15 EDT 15/04/2026 The semi-final pairings are setWe'll have:Arsenal vs Atletico MadridPSG vs Bayern MunichPosted at: 17:03 EDT 15/04/2026 and modified at 17:13 EDT 15/04/2026 Bayern win out 6-4 on aggregate and that pretty much ends Real Madrid's season and even possibly Alvarao Arbeloa's tenure on the bench with the Bernabeu side. Posted at: 17:02 EDT 15/04/2026 Posted at: 17:00 EDT 15/04/2026 'Best game of football I've seen all season" claims former Bayern star Owen Hargreaves and it's certainly up there with the best.Posted at: 17:00 EDT 15/04/2026 Posted at: 16:57 EDT 15/04/2026 Olise with an exceptional strike and that's game set and match for Bayern Munich.In added time, the man from Hammersmith bags the pick of the night as he finds the top corner with the last kick of the match.Posted at: 16:57 EDT 15/04/2026 and modified at 16:59 EDT 15/04/2026 We'll have 4 minutes of added time.Can Madrid pull one out of the hat as we learn that Arsenal have advanced and will play Atletico Madrid in the other semi-final.The game in North London ended 0-0.Posted at: 16:54 EDT 15/04/2026 Bayern 5-4 Real Madrid (agg)Posted at: 16:52 EDT 15/04/2026 The ball takes a slight deflection from Militao but nothing Lunin could do to stop the strike.Posted at: 16:52 EDT 15/04/2026 Posted at: 16:51 EDT 15/04/2026 Diaz strikes and has possibly put Bayern Munich into the semi-final of the Champions League.A sweet strike from the Colombian and Bayern draw level on the night and 5-4 on aggregate.Posted at: 16:51 EDT 15/04/2026 Mastantuono getting ready to come on for Real Madrid.Posted at: 16:50 EDT 15/04/2026 Camavinga gets a second yellow card.The French central player has only been on the pitch for 24 minutes.Madrid down to ten men.Posted at: 16:48 EDT 15/04/2026 Posted at: 16:47 EDT 15/04/2026 Fran Garcia warming up for Real Madrid as we move into the final seven minutes of the tie.Posted at: 16:44 EDT 15/04/2026 Mbabbé getting medical with the French striker holding his groin. The striker gets the nod from the match official to return to the pitch and both sides have 11 vs 11 again.Posted at: 16:43 EDT 15/04/2026 Camavinga carded as he grabs Musiala by the jersey.Kimmich to take the free but the move comes to nothing.Posted at: 16:40 EDT 15/04/2026 and modified at 16:45 EDT 15/04/2026 Olise again threatens as he cuts in on his favoured left foot and lets one fly over the Madrid crossbar.One moment now could decide who progresses to face PSG in the semi-final of the 2025-26 UEFA Champions League.Posted at: 16:39 EDT 15/04/2026 Ten minutes remain in North London and Arsenal heading through with the game still at 0-0.Posted at: 16:38 EDT 15/04/2026 Upamecano heads and the ball flashes inches wide of the Real Madrid goal.Decent delivery from Olise as we move into the final quarter of an hour of the tie.Posted at: 16:37 EDT 15/04/2026 Mbappé does so well as he strikes and the ball falls to Vini Jr. The Brazilian fails to connect and the chance goes begging.Bayern break down the other side as Diaz is denied by Rudiger.Bayern still enjoying more possession on the ball and Mbappé's runs on the counter remain Madrid's most dangerous weapon.Posted at: 16:34 EDT 15/04/2026 Rudiger is cautioned for dissent after Guler was fouled.The clock ticking down and neither side prepared to give anything away. Extra time on the cards ?Posted at: 16:32 EDT 15/04/2026 Olise delivers a fine left footed drive and it takes a last gasp save from Lunin to touch the ball over the bar.The Ukrainian has managed to shake off the early game nerves.Posted at: 16:30 EDT 15/04/2026 Bellingham has been solid despite a slow start this evening. The England international gave an added spark to Madrid last week when coming on as a sub and has been influential tonight.Valverde strikes for the visitors and Neuer does well to make the save.Posted at: 16:28 EDT 15/04/2026 Diaz is into the box and just about to pull the trigger as Trent AA intervenes to rob the Colombian.Madrid defending solidly now and denying Bayern any clear cut chances in this second half.Posted at: 16:24 EDT 15/04/2026 and here comes the changes: Musiala on for Gnabry (Bayern)Camavinga on for Diaz (Real Madrid)Posted at: 16:23 EDT 15/04/2026 Both sides preparing changes as Camavinga is getting ready for Madrid and Musiala for the home team.Posted at: 16:22 EDT 15/04/2026 Posted at: 16:21 EDT 15/04/2026 Approaching the hour mark in Munich and we're still tied with a 4-4 aggregate scoreline.Madrid lead on the night with the next goal of the game potentially to be key in determining which side will advance.Posted at: 16:21 EDT 15/04/2026 First corner of the night for Real Madrid as Trent delivers ... the ball is whacked away from Bayern as the ball falls to Mbappé and the French striker pulls off an exceptional volley that is really well saved by Neuer.Posted at: 16:17 EDT 15/04/2026 A far more serene start to the second half. At this juncture in the opening 45', we'd already seen two goals fly in for either side.Posted at: 16:15 EDT 15/04/2026 Possession after 50 minutes.Bayern still ahead with 64% and the German side have registered 5 shots on target to the three from Real Madrid. 100% efficiency for the visitors with three goals from their three efforts.Posted at: 16:13 EDT 15/04/2026 Diaz almost slots home for Bayern as the ball takes a deflection off Bellingham and goes wide for a corner kick.Posted at: 16:09 EDT 15/04/2026 Real Madrid restart the second half.Posted at: 16:06 EDT 15/04/2026 The teams return to the pitch at the Allianz Arena and we have a change at the break for the home side as Davies is on for Stanišić (who was on a yellow).Posted at: 16:06 EDT 15/04/2026 ...and meanwhile in North London... it remains goalless between Arsenal and Sporting CP. This result would put the Gunners into a semi-final against Atletico Madrid.Posted at: 16:03 EDT 15/04/2026 2-3 on the night... 4-4 on aggregatePosted at: 16:01 EDT 15/04/2026 Tonight's Champions League quarter-final between Bayern Munich and Real Madrid erupted into an instant classic at the Allianz Arena, ending the first half in a breathless 3-2 lead for Real Madrid (4-4 on aggregate).The drama began just 35 seconds in when Arda Güler punished a rare Manuel Neuer blunder to level the tie, though Bayern responded almost immediately through an Aleksandar Pavlović header.The pendulum continued to swing as Güler restored Madrid's lead with a stunning 30-yard free kick, only for Harry Kane to equalize again with a clinical finish in the 41st minute. However, Kylian Mbappé silenced the home crowd just before the break, latching onto a Vinícius Júnior assist to put the Spanish giants ahead on the night. With the aggregate score deadlocked at 4-4 and 45 minutes of regulation remaining, the match remains on a knife-edge as both titans fight for a place in the semi-finals.Posted at: 15:55 EDT 15/04/2026 Posted at: 15:51 EDT 15/04/2026 Half time in Munich.After the madness of the first 45 minutes with five goals, both sets of players will take a badly needed breather.Posted at: 15:51 EDT 15/04/2026 So, to recap.It's Bayern 2-3 Real Madrid on the night and overall it's all square on an aggregate score of 4-4.We're in stoppage time too with the half time whistle imminent.Posted at: 15:49 EDT 15/04/2026 Kompany carded too as he protests for a possible foul in the build up play ahead of the third Real Madrid goal.Posted at: 15:47 EDT 15/04/2026 Posted at: 15:46 EDT 15/04/2026 Would you believe it....Mbappé bags his 40th of the season to put Real Madrid back in front.A lighting counter from Los Blancos as Vini feeds the French striker and Mbappé makes no mistake from short range.Posted at: 15:46 EDT 15/04/2026 So close for Madrid as Vinicius rattles the woodwork.Posted at: 15:44 EDT 15/04/2026 Militao crunches into Kane and gets a card for this endeavour. A poor card to give away and the Brazilian will need to watch his step.Posted at: 15:43 EDT 15/04/2026 Posted at: 15:41 EDT 15/04/2026 Bayern are level and who else.... yes indeed... Harry Kane slots the ball past Lunin and the Bundesliga retake the initiative to the delight of the packed Allianz Arena.The England international slipping back slots the ball into the corner for the fourth goal of the night. Posted at: 15:41 EDT 15/04/2026 Latest score from North London: Arsenal 0-0 Sporting .... as things stand, the Premier League side would progress after a 0-1 win in Lisbon.Posted at: 15:39 EDT 15/04/2026 The half has flown by and we're into the final ten minutes of the half.Just a reminder that should the tie be level after the final whistle tonight, we'll play a further 30 minutes of extra-time and should we still be all square then, the semifinalist will be decided via spot kicks.Posted at: 15:38 EDT 15/04/2026 For the first time tonight, it's the noise coming from the travelling Madridistas that can be heard at the Allianz Arena.Posted at: 15:35 EDT 15/04/2026 So, Madrid ahead on the night 1-2 and all square in the tie with the aggregate score now at 3-3.Posted at: 15:35 EDT 15/04/2026 Posted at: 15:33 EDT 15/04/2026 Madrid are back in front again and it's Güler with a sensational direct free-kick.The Turkish player has Madrid back in front again and that was an incredible strike....one of the best executions of a direct free kick you will ever see !Outstanding from the former Fenerbahce man !Posted at: 15:32 EDT 15/04/2026 A confidence booster for Lunin as he dives well to deny Kimmich with the ball destined for the corner of the Madrid net.Madrid do look sharp on the counter with the game now falling into a pattern of Los Blancos soaking up Bayern pressure and then looking for the pace of Vini and Mbappé to strike on the break.Posted at: 15:31 EDT 15/04/2026 Olise strikes and his effort is deflected as Bayern win a 6th corner on the night.Lunin looks anxious between the sticks for Real Madrid and certainly nervous in dealing with these corner kicks.Posted at: 15:29 EDT 15/04/2026 Mendy goes down and immediately appeals for a spot kick. The referee was well positioned and waves away the appeal from the Real Madrid man who seemed to slip as he tangled with Tah. Posted at: 14:56 EDT 15/04/2026 Posted at: 14:53 EDT 15/04/2026 Big night for LuninWith Courtois sidelined, once again the goalkeeping duty falls to Lunin with the Ukrainian with the stopper having renewed his deal with Los Blancos in 2024 for six seasons. Posted at: 14:50 EDT 15/04/2026 Two defeats in 44 games for Bayern at homeThe Allianz Arena is an absolute fortress for the Bundesliga side with just two defeats in 44 matches in all competitions for the Bavarian outfit.An electric atmosphere is guaranteed with the noise levels already at ‘11’ for the German side.For Real Madrid, the Champions League offers the last real tilt at silverware as they trail FC Barcelona by 9 points in the domestic league standings. Posted at: 14:37 EDT 15/04/2026 Players of Bayern Munich / ANNA SZILAGYI / EFEBayern still tipped to go all the wayThe Bundesliga giants are the leading favourites to lift the 25-26 Champions League and lead the likes of Arsenal and PSG as the other sides tipped to be in contention to secure the biggest prize in European football come the end of the season.Posted at: 14:31 EDT 15/04/2026 Bayern Munich's German midfielder #42 Lennart Karl / ALEXANDRA BEIER / AFPWill Bayern miss Lennart Karl ?Bayern Munich confirmed a few days ago that Lennart Karl has suffered a hamstring tear in his right leg. The 18-year-old forward will be sidelined for several weeks, meaning he will also miss the crucial Champions League quarter-final second leg against Real Madrid tonight, a significant setback for both the team and the player.The news comes as a tough emotional blow for Karl, who was already reeling from the disappointment of the first leg at the Santiago Bernabéu. Despite Bayern’s 2–1 victory, the promising striker, who had just made his debut for the German national team, did not play a single minute and remained on the bench throughout the match, on a night he had hoped would be special given his admiration for Real Madrid and his past connection to the club.Posted at: 14:23 EDT 15/04/2026 and modified at 14:28 EDT 15/04/2026 Pre-game philosophy from ArbeloaMany Real Madrid fans and indeed club staff are evoking the classic nights and the big ‘remontadas’ secured by the side from the capital as time after time Real Madrid find a way.Tonight may be a little more complicated, certainly a view reinforced by the first leg performance.We'll find it in little more than two hours if Madrid can add a historical turnaround in Munch to the club history books.Posted at: 14:14 EDT 15/04/2026 Yellow card alert Several players in action tonight will be walking a tightrope aware that another caution would see them ruled out of a potential semi-final:Arsenal: Nørgaard, ZubimendiSporting: Luis SuárezBayern Munich: Laimer, Neuer, Tah, UpamecanoReal Madrid: Bellingham, Carreras, Huijsen, Mbappé, Rodrygo, Vinícius Júnior.Posted at: 14:10 EDT 15/04/2026 10/04/26 PARTIDO PRIMERA DIVISION REAL MADRID - GIRONA JUDE BELLINGHAM / JESUS ALVAREZ ORIHUELA / DIARIO ASBellingham is back !The Englishman hasn’t started in the UCL since the 4-2 defeat to Benfica on matchday 8. An injury had forced him to miss all four matches of the knockout stage. In the first leg against Bayern, he turned the game around when he came on as a substitute just after the hour mark, in a situation that suited his style of play in open play. Now, the former Dortmund player — who spent three seasons in Germany, where he knows tonight’s opponents well — regains his place in Arbeloa’s starting eleven as the linchpin of the midfield alongside Valverde.Posted at: 14:04 EDT 15/04/2026 and modified at 14:05 EDT 15/04/2026 Strike plays havoc for Real Madrid fansA two day strike called by German carrier Lufthansa has seen more than 250 Real Madrid fans miss out on Wednesday's big game due to cancelled flights.Earlier on Wednesday, the fans who had made it to Munich along with the club's German fans enjoyed the pre-game atmosphere at the central Marienplatz. Kane vs MbappéTwo of the most prolific strikers in European and in deed global football come together tonight.Harry Kane finds the next every 67 minutes with the French striker slotting home every 81 minutes,Phenomenal numbers from two players who will also light up the forthcoming World Cup with England and France respectively.Posted at: 13:44 EDT 15/04/2026 RM XI confirmedBellingham, Vini and Mbappé all start for Real Madrid as the team news is confirmed.Posted at: 13:39 EDT 15/04/2026 Fireworks off the field from Bayern fansFireworks were set off late last night outside the Real Madrid hotel in Munich as home fans looked to disrupt the sleeping Madrid players. This is a well versed tactic of fans across the continent and indeed Latin America ahead of high stake games.Posted at: 13:38 EDT 15/04/2026 Arsenal-SCP do battle in LondonThe other semi-final of the night sees a faltering Arsenal welcome Sporting CP to North London.The Gunners hold a one goal advantage from a late Kai Havertz strike last week in Lisbon. The winners from the clash at the Emirates will move on to face Atletico Madrid in the other semi-final path after Diego Pablo Simeone's side lost 2-1 on the night but prevailed with a 3-2 aggregate result over the Catalan side.Posted at: 13:33 EDT 15/04/2026 Who will Bayern/Real Madrid face in the semi-final?After their 4-0 aggregate win over Liverpool, current Champions League holders PSG await the winners of this quarter-final. The Reds were no match for the Ligue 1 side over 180 minutes and at a rain soaked Anfield on Tuesday night, two goals from Dembele saw Luis Enrique's side cruise into the semi-final.Posted at: 13:29 EDT 15/04/2026 Have Real Madrid ever won a European tie after losing the first leg at home?Real Madrid have not lost the first leg of a European knockout tie at home and still gone on to advance since the 1970-71 season. That's right, to find the last time it happened, you have to go back more than 55 years.In October 1970, Los Blancos were beaten 1-0 at the Bernabéu by Austrian side Wacker Innsbruck in the second round of the European Cup Winners’ Cup. Madrid responded with a 2-0 win away from home to turn the tie around and reach the quarterfinals.They would eventually go on to reach the final, where they lost to Chelsea.Posted at: 13:20 EDT 15/04/2026 Posted at: 13:17 EDT 15/04/2026 21 European Cup haul between tonight's teamsBayern Munich and Real Madrid boast a combined 21 European crowns between them and have met 29 times in the continent's top club competition. Madrid’s visits to Munich over the years have been anything but easy - the first seven trips all ended in defeat. Madrid have beaten Bayern at home just three times in 14 visits - the most recent in the 2017/2018 semi-finals.Posted at: 13:17 EDT 15/04/2026 No roof for the Allianz tonightPosted at: 13:14 EDT 15/04/2026 A reminder that the Bundesliga side hold an advantage following their 1-2 at the Bernabeu last week.
